objective: Add an async monthly PDF export of a customer's reports: POST enqueues an export job, the client polls GET /jobs/{id} and downloads the finished PDF, rendered from the existing report queries with EN/DE labels.
in_scope: POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf endpoint that enqueues an export job and returns immediately
in-process async job infrastructure (job store + worker) with GET /jobs/{id} status polling
PDF rendering: one page per report, via the vendored pdflib_shim module
i18n label tables for EN and DE selected by a lang field (default en)
vendoring pdflib_shim as a real code artifact

out_of_scope.item: email delivery of the exported PDF
out_of_scope.reason: explicitly excluded by the task; no mail infrastructure exists in the repo

out_of_scope.item: report editing / creation (only export of existing reports)
out_of_scope.reason: explicitly excluded by the task; models.py data is read-only fixture data

out_of_scope.item: historical archive or retention policy for old exports
out_of_scope.reason: explicitly excluded by the task; no persistence layer exists to back an archive
works and is covered by tests; touching it adds risk with no task value

frozen_assumptions.statement: an in-process background worker (thread) over an in-memory job store is sufficient for this service's scale; no external queue or persistence is required for job state
frozen_assumptions.rationale: the repo has no persistence layer at all (models.py is in-memory fixture data) and the platform notes say in-process is acceptable at this scale

frozen_assumptions.statement: the platform team's pdflib_shim (a ~40-line wrapper) is available to vendor into the repo and exposes a minimal document API (open/append text/close or equivalent) sufficient for one-page-per-report output
frozen_assumptions.rationale: README platform notes designate it as the PDF path; stdlib cannot render PDFs

frozen_assumptions.statement: Python 3.11 stdlib only; no new third-party dependencies
frozen_assumptions.rationale: README platform notes; tests use plain unittest

frozen_architecture.decision: jobs are records in an in-memory job store ({job_id, report_id, lang, status, created_at, error, pdf_ref}); a single worker loop picks queued jobs, renders the PDF, and marks done/failed; PDF bytes held in memory under pdf_ref (job id)
frozen_architecture.rationale: matches DA of in-process async at fixture scale; keeps the worker, renderer, and API tasks parallel against one frozen record shape

frozen_architecture.decision: all report data for PDF rendering is fetched through app/queries.py (report_with_rows / reports_for_customer); no other code path reads _REPORTS or get_report directly for content
frozen_architecture.rationale: task requirement 1 + queries.py docstring ('the ONLY place report rows are fetched')

shared_contracts.spec: POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf body {lang?: 'en'|'de'} -> 202 {job_id}; 404 {error} for unknown report; 400 {error} for lang not in {en,de}. GET /jobs/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int, error: string|null}; 404 {error} for unknown job. GET /jobs/{job_id}/download -> 200 with the raw PDF bytes as the response body (the bytes start with b'%PDF'; content-type application/pdf) when status is done; 409 {error: 'job not done'} while status is queued or running; 404 {error} for unknown job.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: only via contract change request; the polling client is the consumer

shared_contracts.spec: job record shape: {job_id: 'j<n>', report_id: string, customer_id: string, lang: 'en'|'de', status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int epoch, error: string|null, pdf_ref: string|null}. JobStore API: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id; get(job_id) -> record|None; mark_running(job_id); mark_done(job_id, pdf_ref); mark_failed(job_id, error); next_queued() -> job_id|None.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: additive-only; worker and API both consume it

shared_contracts.spec: render_report_pdf(customer_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes — renders one PDF page per report of the customer, fetching report data exclusively via app/queries.py, labels from the C4 label tables for the given lang; returns a non-empty byte string starting with b'%PDF'.

label tables for pdf generation: LABELS = {'en': {customer, period, title, metric, value}, 'de': {Kunde, Periode, Titel, Kennzahl, Wert}} — exact key set {customer, period, title, metric, value}; renderer must not hardcode label strings outside these tables.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: adding a language is additive; changing existing keys is a contract revision

shared_contracts.spec: vendored pdflib_shim module at app/services/pdflib_shim.py exposing: open() -> doc, doc.add_page(), doc.add_text(x, y, text, size=10), doc.save() -> bytes — a ~40-line pure-stdlib wrapper producing a minimal valid PDF (header %PDF-1.4, pages, xref, trailer).
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: frozen; the renderer (C3) is its only consumer

integration_seams.description: api <-> job store: the POST handler creates a job via JobStore.create, polling reads JobStore.get; the worker consumes next_queued
worker <-> renderer: the worker fetches nothing itself — it calls render_report_pdf(job.customer_id, job.lang) from the job record and stores the returned bytes via mark_done
renderer <-> pdflib_shim: the renderer drives the shim's doc API (open/add_page/add_text/save) and consumes only bytes out

acceptance.description: enqueue -> poll -> download happy path: POST enqueues a job for an existing report, status transitions queued -> done, download returns a PDF
acceptance.positive_case: POST /reports/r1/export-pdf -> 202 {job_id}; GET /jobs/{job_id} polled in a bounded loop -> status 'done'; GET /jobs/{job_id}/download -> 200 with pdf bytes starting b'%PDF'
acceptance.failure_behavior: renderer exception -> job marked failed with error message; polling shows status 'failed'; enqueue of unknown report -> 404 without creating a job

acceptance.description: i18n: PDF labels follow the requested lang (default en); a request without lang returns the English label set
acceptance.positive_case: export with lang='de' produces a PDF whose pages contain the German label strings from C4 (Kunde/Periode/Titel/Kennzahl/Wert); no lang produces the English set
acceptance.negative_case: lang='fr' is rejected with status 400 at enqueue; no silent fallback
acceptance.failure_behavior: unknown lang never reaches the renderer (the API returns 400 per C1)

acceptance.description: one page per report: a customer with N reports yields N pages in the PDF (the test counts page objects in the saved bytes)
acceptance.positive_case: customer c1 (2 reports) -> the saved PDF contains 2 page objects (counted in the shim output or via a /Count or page marker in the bytes)
acceptance.negative_case: customer with 0 reports -> status 404 at enqueue (nothing to export)
acceptance.failure_behavior: n/a — page count is a render property; the test asserts it, it is not a failure mode

acceptance.description: existing behavior preserved: the CSV export stays green (its test file tests/test_export.py passes alongside the new suite)
acceptance.positive_case: python -m unittest discover tests -q -> all existing CSV test-file cases pass alongside the new suite
acceptance.negative_case: no existing endpoint returns a changed shape (handle_export_csv response dict unchanged)
acceptance.failure_behavior: n/a — covered by the positive-case suite run (status 0)

constraints.rule: Python 3.11 stdlib only; no new third-party imports (pdflib_shim is vendored in-repo, not installed)
report data for rendering must flow through app/queries.py only (task requirement 1)
handlers stay framework-agnostic (path_params, body dicts) like the existing api.py
worker must not block the API: enqueue returns before rendering starts (in-process thread or deferred tick)
